title: IS FAIRNESS ONLY METRIC DEEP? EVALUATING AND ADDRESSING SUBGROUP GAPS IN DML
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. The benchmark, finDML, is designed to measure fairness gaps in deep metric learning representations, focusing on sensitive attributes like race, skintone, and artificially induced class imbalance in image datasets.
findings: There are no findings related to religion, as the paper's scope is limited to fairness in deep metric learning concerning visual and demographic attributes in image datasets, not religious ones.
